text.tspan: POST /api/sync {email, entries, projects, prompts, hostname, IPs}

g.text: Determine if prompts should sync (every 24h by default)

text.tspan: For each file: check offset vs size + fingerprint
• Appended (size>offset, fingerprint match) → read from offset
Collect cwd paths for project discovery

g.text: If no new data → saveState(offsets) → exit early
